messages:
Nina (docs): I pushed a tiny PR to add an export example + CSV->JSONL mapping for audit logs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534
Jared (eng): Nice. Quick q: primary example JSONL or CSV?
Nina (docs): JSONL primary, CSV mapping included. Want the samples to be clearly non-sensitive and match the runtime event fields.
Priya (legal): Please use placeholders for sensitive fields (e.g., \"ip\": \"<redacted>\") or a hashed token. Do not use the word \"anonymized\" unless irreversible.
Luis (platform): Suggest adding an \"export_id\" and \"exported_by\" in the metadata so customers can correlate. Use \"hashed_exported_by\" in public examples.
Jared (eng): Also include \"actor_type\" and show \"hashed_actor_id\". We emit optional \"kms_key_id\" so add it as an optional field in the sample.
Nina (docs): Current snippet in PR (fenced):```json
{"__meta":{"export_time":"2025-11-05T09:00:00Z","export_id":"exp-01ab23","exported_by":"hashed:9b74c9897bac770ffc029102a200c5de"},"timestamp":"2025-11-05T08:59:59Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:3c6e0b8a9c15224a","actor_type":"user","event_type":"api_key.rotate","ip":"<redacted>","kms_key_id":"optional:kms-01","details":{"client":"js","action":"RotateKey"}}
```
Priya (legal): That looks fine. Two copy tweaks: 1) use phrase \"pseudonymized or redacted\" in explanatory text; 2) add a short caption: \"Shown values are pseudonymized or redacted for documentation purposes.\"
docs-linter: lint warning - sample-json-literal should be fenced with ```json (ok).
Nina (docs): Thanks! I updated wording & added the caption. Requested legal ACK on the PR and will merge after CI + ACK. :thumbsup:
